+----------------------+
| <<abstract>>         |
| Vehicle              |
+----------------------+
| -String vin          |
| #int year            |
| +String make         |
| +String model        |
+----------------------+
| +start() : bool      |
| +stop() : void       |
| +fuelLevel() : float |
+----------------------+

+----------------------------------+
| Car                              |
+----------------------------------+
| -int numDoors                    |
| -bool sunroof                    |
+----------------------------------+
| +openTrunk() : void              |
| +setSeatPosition(int pos) : void |
+----------------------------------+

+---------------------------+
| Truck                     |
+---------------------------+
| -float payloadCapacity    |
| -bool fourWheelDrive      |
+---------------------------+
| +lowerTailgate() : void   |
| +towingCapacity() : float |
+---------------------------+

+---------------------+
| Engine              |
+---------------------+
| -float displacement |
| -int horsepower     |
| -String fuelType    |
+---------------------+
| +ignite() : bool    |
| +shutdown() : void  |
| +rpm() : int        |
+---------------------+

+-----------------------------------+
| Fleet                             |
+-----------------------------------+
| -String companyName               |
| -List<Vehicle> vehicles           |
+-----------------------------------+
| +addVehicle(Vehicle v) : void     |
| +removeVehicle(String vin) : bool |
| +totalVehicles() : int            |
+-----------------------------------+

relations:
id(bytes=7)="Vehicle" <|--                                                   id(bytes=3)="Car"     : extends
id(bytes=7)="Vehicle" <|--                                                   id(bytes=5)="Truck"   : extends
id(bytes=7)="Vehicle" endpoint1=[bytes=1 "1"] *-- endpoint2=[bytes=1 "1"]    id(bytes=6)="Engine"  : has
id(bytes=5)="Fleet"   endpoint1=[bytes=1 "1"] o-- endpoint2=[bytes=4 "0..*"] id(bytes=7)="Vehicle" : manages
